_comment: The coverage floors this repository holds itself to. scripts/ci/check_coverage_thresholds.py reads this file and fails the build when a floor is not met. The floors only ever go up: coverage is raised in steps, and each step raises the floor to match what the repository actually holds, so a regression is caught by the next push instead of months later. The target for this repository is backend 99% total / 98% per file and frontend 99% total / 98% per file.
